note: Actual export shipments are confirmed by dated Indian customs records with B/L number, destination and HS codes: 2026-01-15, Jogbani (INJBNB) → Biratnagar, Nepal, buyer K.B. INTERNATIONAL, B/L 8774025, HS 84123100 / 84129090 / 84812000. Note the declared HS 903281 (pneumatic/hydraulic regulating instruments) does not match the observed codes — the actual shipped goods are pneumatic cylinders (8412) and solenoid valves (8481); per project rules this is not a rejection ground, the code should be corrected to the factual one. The company is also an importer: supplier table shows NINGBO INTELL PNEUMATIC TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD (China) with 1048 shipments, i.e. it imports Chinese pneumatic components and re-exports/sells them — role is likely manufacturer_trader or trader, not a pure manufacturer. Domestic supply evidence could not be verified: the web_search tool was unavailable (searx connection refused) and registry/aggregator pages (thecompanycheck, eximpedia, volza) returned HTTP 403, so GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report splits are null — not public in what I could reach.
